name: org.dync.ijkplayerlib.widget.receiver.NetworkChangedReceiver
description: Dynckathline IJKPlayerLib declares this receiver without an automatic manifest filter; a video screen can register it for Android connectivity changes, and it reports whether Wi-Fi or mobile data is connected and available.
disableEffect: The manifest declaration receives no automatic connectivity broadcasts, so disabling it does not remove normal playback or current-network checks.
